title: R$^2$A: Learning Persona Policies Through Persona Representation Learning and Runtime Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.29798v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The same Persona behavior can be beneficial in one context but harmful in another, causing static Persona elicitation to perform inconsistently across tasks. We introduce the Persona Selection--Realization Framework, which models behavior generation through a latent Persona state and decomposes it into Persona Selection and Persona Realization. The discrepancies between static Persona elicitation and an ideal Persona policy in these two components define the Selection Gap and Realization Gap, respectively. Building on this framework, we propose R$^2$A, a two-stage approach for learning Persona policies. Persona Representation Learning uses structured Who--How--What presentations to encode the target Persona's objective, conditional behavioral principles, and trajectory-level manifestations. translated_title: R²A：通过角色表示学习与运行时对齐来学习角色策略
translated_abstract: 同一种角色（Persona）行为在一种情境中可能有益，而在另一种情境中却可能有害，这使得静态的角色引导在不同任务上的表现不一致。我们提出了角色选择—实现框架，该框架通过潜在角色状态对行为生成进行建模，并将其分解为角色选择与角色实现两个组成部分。静态角色引导与理想角色策略在这两个组件上的差异，分别被定义为选择差距与实现差距。基于该框架，我们提出了R²A——一种用于学习角色策略的两阶段方法。其中，角色表示学习利用结构化的“谁—如何—什么”表示来编码目标角色的目标、条件性行为原则以及轨迹层面的具体表现；角色运行时对齐则移除显式的角色规范，并联合校准行为选择与轨迹实现。
tldr: 提出将角色行为生成建模为角色选择与角色实现的角色选择—实现框架，并通过R²A两阶段方法（结构化角色表示学习加运行时对齐）学习角色策略，在不依赖显式角色规范的情况下实现跨任务一致的角色行为控制。
en_tdlr: R²A introduces a Persona Selection-Realization Framework and a two-stage method (Persona Representation Learning with structured Who-How-What representations plus Runtime Alignment) to learn persona policies that remain consistent across tasks without explicit persona specifications.
